name: gtm-notify
description: Pings Slack, Discord or any webhook (Zapier, n8n, Make, Clay) when Claude finishes a turn or needs you, with Claude's actual message in the ping.

slack_webhook_url.title: Slack incoming webhook URL
slack_webhook_url.description: Optional. Slack: Apps > Incoming Webhooks > Add to channel. Leave empty to skip Slack.

discord_webhook_url.title: Discord webhook URL
discord_webhook_url.description: Optional. Discord: channel settings > Integrations > Webhooks. Leave empty to skip Discord.

webhook_url.title: Any other webhook URL (Zapier, n8n, Make, Clay)
webhook_url.description: Optional. Receives one JSON object per event (see the plugin README for the fields).

ping_on_stop.title: Ping every time Claude finishes a turn
ping_on_stop.description: Off = ping only when Claude is waiting for you (permission prompt, idle, a question).

max_chars.title: How many characters of Claude's message to include
max_chars.description: 0 sends no message text, only the project name and event.
